entities.name: tracker.py
entities.description: Daily prediction-vs-actual tracker for fuel prices. Captures cheapest prices at scheduled hours (14:00, 21:00 Helsinki), runs predictions, stores to daily_tracker collection, and sends notifications. Includes unified scheduler for both notification captures and silent scrapes.

entities.name: tankille.py
entities.description: Scraper for tankille.fi per-city fuel price data. PRIMARY data source for per-city cheapest and average prices. Parses HTML tables with fuel tabs (fuel-95, fuel-dsl) and extracts station names, prices, and freshness.

entities.name: polttoaine.py
entities.description: Scraper for polttoaine.net '20 cheapest' national page. SECONDARY data source used for cross-checking. Parses Latin-1 encoded HTML table with top 20 cheapest stations nationwide.

entities.name: hintatutka.py
entities.description: EXPERIMENTAL scraper for hintatutka.fi. Not part of production scrape path unless ENABLE_HINTATUTKA_EXPERIMENTAL=1. Needs verification against live site HTML.

entities.name: validation.py
entities.description: Shared validation utilities for scraped fuel price data. Provides hard bounds checking (1.10-3.50 EUR/L), IQR-based outlier detection, and cross-fuel price relationship validation.

entities.name: weather.py
entities.description: Weather and road condition data for Finnish fuel demand modeling. Fetches from FMI Open Data and Digitraffic. EXPERIMENTAL - not currently wired into predictions. Provides winter severity index and demand adjustment calculations.

entities.name: traffic.py
entities.description: Fintraffic Digitraffic traffic volume data as fuel demand proxy. Uses LAM (Automatic Traffic Measurement) station data to calculate national traffic index. EXPERIMENTAL - not wired into predictions yet.

entities.name: weekly_cycle.py
entities.description: Weekly fuel pricing cycle detection and prediction. Identifies price jump patterns (typical ti-ke rise, su-ma drop), calculates average cycle length, and predicts next jump timing. Requires minimum 21 daily points.

entities.name: App.js
entities.description: Main React frontend application component. Single-file 1273-line component with landing hero, dark prediction card, tracking charts, city averages, regional grid, and real-time SSE updates. Dark theme by default.

entities.name: tailwind.config.js
entities.description: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens for dark/light themes. Defines color system (ink, muted, secondary, surface, line), cycle phase colors, recommendation colors, custom fonts, and animations.

entities.name: index.css
entities.description: Global CSS with Tailwind imports, CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, dark mode retargeting rules for Recharts, grain texture, scrollbar styling, and accessibility (skip-link, reduced-motion).

entities.name: App.css
entities.description: Component-level CSS for landing hero, data plane, metrics grid, price displays, and responsive breakpoints. Includes custom CSS variables for landing section backgrounds, borders, and gradients in both light/dark modes.

entities.name: vercel.json
entities.description: Vercel deployment configuration for Create React App. Defines SPA rewrites, static asset caching (31536000s immutable), and build commands. Framework: create-react-app, output: build/.

entities.name: package.json
entities.description: Frontend NPM package manifest. React 18.3, Recharts 2.12, Framer Motion 11, Lucide icons, Axios, Tailwind. Version 2.0.0. Scripts: start, build, test.

entities.name: index.html
entities.description: Main HTML template with no-FOUC theme script (default dark), Finnish meta tags, Google Fonts (IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono), and Font Share (Cabinet Grotesk). Theme-color meta tag switches based on theme.

entities.name: privacy.html
entities.description: Finnish GDPR-compliant privacy policy (Tietosuojaseloste). States no user data collection, no cookies, no analytics, no tracking. Only platform-level logs (Railway/Vercel). Updated 2026-05-18.

entities.name: postcss.config.js
entities.description: PostCSS configuration with Tailwind and Autoprefixer plugins.

entities.name: test_bensavahti_api.py
entities.description: Pytest suite for backend API endpoints. Tests health, meta, seed, prices/current, prices/history, factors, predict/run, predict/latest, regional, accuracy. Validates data structure, sorting, and constraints.

entities.name: test_verification.py
entities.description: Test script for price verification system with mock DB. Tests hard bounds, historical deviation, daily change limits, and suggested alternatives. 7 test cases covering outliers, jumps, and normal ranges.

entities.name: test_news.py
entities.description: Test script for enhanced news module. Tests basic scraping, AI relevance scoring, and full workflow (scrape + AI + filter). Includes async tests for AI analysis.

entities.name: daily_tracker
entities.description: MongoDB collection storing real fuel price captures at 14:00 and 21:00 Helsinki. Fields: date, hour, fuel, region, actual_cheapest, by_city (cheapest+average per city), prediction_for_tomorrow_cheapest, prediction_full, hourly_predictions, best_window. Unique index on (fuel, region, date, hour).

entities.name: price_observations
entities.description: MongoDB collection for silent scrape observations (hours outside scheduled captures). Stores cheapest price, station, city, by_city breakdown, but no predictions or notifications.

entities.name: Scraper Output Contract
entities.description: Shared output format for all scrapers: {city, station, address, price, date, age_hours, fuel, source, chain, raw_name}. All scrapers must return list of dicts matching this schema.

relationships.description: tracker.py uses tankille.py as PRIMARY scraper for per-city data in capture_daily and silent_scrape
tracker.py uses polttoaine.py as SECONDARY scraper for national cross-check
tracker.py validates scraped prices through validation.py before storing to daily_tracker
capture_daily() writes verified capture + prediction to daily_tracker with (date, hour, fuel, region) unique key
silent_scrape() writes observation-only data to price_observations for non-scheduled hours
tankille.py returns list of dicts matching scraper output contract
polttoaine.py returns list of dicts matching scraper output contract
hintatutka.py implements scraper contract but is experimental/disabled by default
validation.py applies hard bounds and IQR outlier detection to scraper output
App.js uses Tailwind design tokens defined in tailwind.config.js
App.js imports global styles from index.css (Tailwind base/components/utilities)
App.js imports component-specific styles from App.css
index.html mounts React app in #root div, applies theme script before first paint
vercel.json references package.json build/start commands for deployment
test_bensavahti_api.py validates tracker endpoints (predict/latest, accuracy) behavior
test_verification.py validates price verification logic with mock DB
test_news.py validates news scraping and AI relevance scoring used by tracker news_watch_loop
tracker.py can integrate weekly_cycle predictions (currently not wired in)
weather.py provides demand adjustment calculations but is not yet wired into tracker predictions (experimental)
traffic.py provides traffic demand proxy but is not yet wired into tracker predictions (experimental)
App.js reads daily_tracker data via /api/track/history to render TrackingChart and CityAverageChart
tailwind.config.js defines design tokens consumed by CSS custom properties in index.css
postcss.config.js processes Tailwind directives from tailwind.config.js

scraper contract: standardized output format across all scrapers
validation pipeline: hard bounds + IQR outlier detection
experimental modules not yet wired into production predictions

single-file 1273-line React app with inline styles
daily_tracker unique index on (fuel, region, date, hour)
